question: In what time (in years) will ₹2,800 fetch an interest of ₹700 at 5% per year simple interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2,800

Interest (I) = ₹700

Rate of Interest (R) = 5% per year

**Formula used:**

S.I. = (P times R times T)/(100)

Where, T = Time (in years)

**Calculation:**

700 = (2800 times 5 times T)/(100)

⇒ (2800 times 5 times T)/(100) = 700

⇒ (140T)/(10) = 700

⇒ 14T = 70

⇒ T = 5 years

∴ The correct answer is option (2).
